candidate_pool_oracle.definition: Upper bound if reranker places gold evidence at Rank 1 whenever it is in the 50 candidate pool.

reranker_oracle_on_pool_hits.definition: Potential gain from improving the cross-encoder among the 30 questions where gold evidence reaches the pool.

retrieval_path_union_oracle.definition: Upper bound if fusion and candidate selection perfectly captured any gold chunk retrieved by either BM25 (k=100) or Dense FAISS (k=100).
